_comment: Generated height field, one per map. Value noise seeded from the map text, so a level's ridges and valleys are identical on every reload and for every player. Bands are checked low to high: the last band whose `min` is at or below the tile's height wins. Tower multipliers apply to a tower built on the tile; enemy multipliers apply to an enemy standing on it.
_design: Every band is two-sided on purpose. High ground adds range but costs damage; low ground does the reverse. Enemies on high ground are slower but take less damage; enemies in valleys are faster but take more. Nothing is a free win, and the map's shape becomes part of the build decision.
_bands_note: min is a fraction of the normalised height field, so every map spans the full range from Valley to Peak.
